subject.title: feat: Plugin API for TUI footer status contributions (registerStatusProvider)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `PluginStatusProvider` / `registerStatusProvider` as a public Plugin SDK seam for TUI footer status contributions, and if so what return shape and rendering boundary should it expose?
rationale: The request adds public plugin API surface and crosses Plugin SDK, registry, and TUI behavior, so automation cannot choose the long-term contract safely.

options.title: Accept narrow status-provider API
options.body: Approve a small Plugin SDK registration seam and keep TUI ordering, truncation, and theming as the follow-up rendering contract.

options.title: Fold into broader footer customization
options.body: Defer the plugin API until the broader footer-template/custom-field tracker settles the product model.

options.title: Reject core SDK seam
options.body: Keep footer extensions outside core for now and ask plugin authors to use existing external or extension-specific surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow status-provider API
recommendation.body: Approve a small Plugin SDK registration seam and keep TUI ordering, truncation, and theming as the follow-up rendering contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest ownership signal is the original plugin architecture and TUI status history this API would extend.
